characters.storyAppearance: Adult cloned body without ancestral memories, near-waist black hair; fine growth-monitor scars, chosen ceremonial collar; later old hands, widened imperial rings, gold mantle and thin soles.
visualInterpretation: ONE identity at two time states. Second complete full-body 'Sixty years later': unmistakably ELDERLY SAME WOMAN, deeply lined face, stooped slightly, veined aged attached hands bearing a few widened imperial rings, hair still dyed BLACK to waist, no youthful skin. Both wear floor-length black fabric royal gown with broad gold/turquoise collar and geometric gold trim, gold mantle draped from shoulders, simple thin-soled gold sandals. Keep hems, hair and sandals complete and inside generous margins, no enormous trailing train. Third study is a matching ELDERLY head portrait. One sheet ONE person, not two queens. Name Merneith exact; small age-state labels. No crown required, no wings, throne, ankh prop, magic eyes or glow skin. Finely understated old monitor scars on forearms only if visible; no wounds. Aging is binding, original youthful reference supplies costume accents only.

characters.role: Builder, companion and sovereign who resigns

selectionEvidence.quote: She wore gray work cloth like the day of Merneith's waking. Her hair was cropped close again.
selectionEvidence.explanation: Source central role and binding age/state.

Third matching elderly head portrait. Wry independent expression, ordinary person, no crown, collar, jewelry, wings or eternal youth.
